title: LongReasonArena: A Long Reasoning Benchmark for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2508.19363v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Existing long-context benchmarks for Large Language Models (LLMs) focus on evaluating comprehension of long inputs, while overlooking the evaluation of long reasoning abilities. To address this gap, we introduce LongReasonArena, a benchmark specifically designed to assess the long reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Our tasks require models to solve problems by executing multi-step algorithms that reflect key aspects of long reasoning, such as retrieval and backtracking. By controlling the inputs, the required reasoning length can be arbitrarily scaled, reaching up to 1 million tokens of reasoning for the most challenging tasks. Extensive evaluation results demonstrate that LongReasonArena presents a significant challenge for both open-source and proprietary LLMs. For instance, even GPT-5 achieves only 27.8% accuracy on Level 3. Further analysis also reveals that the accuracy exhibits a linear decline with respect to the logarithm

translated_title: LongReasonArena：面向大语言模型的长推理基准
translated_abstract: 现有的大语言模型（LLM）长上下文基准主要专注于评估模型对长输入的理解能力，而忽视了对长推理能力的评估。为了弥补这一空白，我们提出了LongReasonArena，一个专门用于评估大语言模型长推理能力的基准。我们的任务要求模型通过执行多步骤算法来解决问题，这些算法反映了长推理的关键方面，例如检索和回溯。通过控制输入，所需的推理长度可以任意扩展，最具挑战性的任务的推理长度可达100万个token。大量评估结果表明，LongReasonArena对开源和闭源大语言模型都构成了重大挑战。例如，即使是GPT-5在Level 3上也仅达到27.8%的准确率。进一步分析还表明，准确率随推理长度的对数呈线性下降。
tldr: 提出了专门评估大语言模型长推理能力的LongReasonArena基准，其任务可任意扩展推理长度至100万token，结果显示即使GPT-5等最强模型准确率也仅有27.8%。
